title: The Agentic Organization: Transforming Every Role and Workflow Part 3
description: Agentic work moves beyond basic AI interaction, creating a fundamental transformation in how your teams operate and deliver value. In this session on the agentic workplace, we will explore how different departments of a company, like Sales, Marketing, HR, and Product Management, are using AI agents to work more efficiently and creatively. We’ll walk through how sales teams can leverage agents to automate lead qualification and meeting prep, how marketing can generate high-quality, personalized campaign content faster, and how product managers can enhance product feature discovery and development. We’ll also talk about how agents are governed, and can be deployed across the entire organization to benefit all teams. Join us to envision a future where every employee is empowered by AI agents.
